purpose: Defines the workflow classification engine, bimodal interaction modeling, dynamic category discovery, and RTK modern CLI missed-savings rules for Lumen.
scope: Covers crates/lumen-insights: WorkflowClassifier, CategoryDetector, RtkOpportunityRule, FindingGenerator, BimodalClassifier, and RollupEngine.
non_goals: Raw SQLite database table management (handled by lumen-store).
Active code execution or test running (handled by prism-core).

api_surface.name: WorkflowClassifier
api_surface.signature: pub struct WorkflowClassifier; impl WorkflowClassifier { pub fn classify_seed(transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> Vec<CategoryScore>; pub fn discover_fingerprint(transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> Option<DiscoveredCategory>; pub fn classify_bimodal(transcript: &CanonicalTranscript) -> BimodalMode; }
api_surface.description: Classifies session transcripts into seed categories (feature_dev, bug_hunt, refactoring, test_authoring, eval) and discovers new category clusters.

api_surface.name: RtkOpportunityRule
api_surface.signature: pub struct RtkOpportunityRule; impl RtkOpportunityRule { pub fn evaluate(commands: &[CommandEventRecord]) -> Vec<StructuredFinding>; }
api_surface.description: Evaluates command event sequences to detect legacy POSIX tool invocations (grep, find, cat, cd) and generate actionable modern CLI recommendations.

api_surface.name: FindingGenerator
api_surface.signature: pub struct FindingGenerator; impl FindingGenerator { pub fn generate_findings(transcript: &CanonicalTranscript, loop_anomalies: &[CycleAnomaly]) -> Vec<StructuredFinding>; }
api_surface.description: Synthesizes structured findings containing severity, confidence, rule version, evidence JSON, and remediation recommendations.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WHEN a session contains high tool mutation density and low search turn count, THE SYSTEM SHALL classify its bimodal mode as BimodalMode::Acceleration.
WHEN a session contains high search tool density and high turn count, THE SYSTEM SHALL classify its bimodal mode as BimodalMode::Exploration.
WHEN a command event sequence contains grep or egrep invocations, THE SYSTEM SHALL emit an RTK opportunity finding recommending ripgrep (rg) with an estimated speedup metric.
WHEN a command event sequence contains find invocations, THE SYSTEM SHALL emit an RTK opportunity finding recommending fd to prevent traversing ignored build directories.
WHEN structured findings are generated, THE SYSTEM SHALL populate evidence_json, confidence score in [0.0, 1.0], rule_or_model_version, and actionable recommendation text.
WHEN computing periodic rollups, THE SYSTEM SHALL aggregate session count, total cost USD, active wall time, and finding counts by repository, category, and weekly period start.

reasoning: Establishes workflow categorization, bimodal theory modeling, RTK missed savings coaching, and structured finding generation.
